messages:
Maya K: Quick sync — starting a stability sweep for the new quant8 model bring-up. Observed a small uptick in hallucination rate on long-instruction prompts. Need to refresh promptbank samples + golden set and coordinate labeling. Can folks confirm avail for a short handoff?

Devon L: +1. What sample size are you thinking? Also we should include the 4k+ ctx examples we saw fail.

Maya K: Thinking 1k stratified by domain (docs, user-mails, code, cli). Include 200 longctx (>2048 tokens) anchors. Plan: dedupe -> sampling -> golden labeling -> smoke eval. Timeline: gate in 48h.

Sandeep: For dedupe, can we relax near-duplicate threshold to 0.85 Jaccard? Last run was 0.9 and missed paraphrases.

Ivy: Labeler team can take ~300/day per annotator. We have 6 annotators free tomorrow. Need CSV export with columns: id, text, domain, ctx_len.

Liam: I can run the quant smoke bench once sample ready — will test q8 and q4_kv kernels. Will post perf + quality diffs to this thread.

Maya K: Thanks — here's the sampling command I'm using:
```
python tools/sample_bank.py --src=promptbank/latest.parquet \n  --dedupe=true --min_len=20 --max_len=8000 --strata=domain,ctx_bucket \n  --out=stability_sweep_2812345678.csv
```

Ivy: can you add `--min_token_entropy=1.2`? reduces boilerplate duplicates.

Devon L: Also add an embed-fingerprint column for post-labeler dedupe: `--fingerprint=embed128`.

Maya K: done. Uploading CSV to /shared/curation/stability_sweep/ now. ops-bot: job 4921 triggered for dedupe + fingerprinting.

ops-bot: Job 4921 queued by Maya K. ETA ~12m.

Sandeep: For golden set, propose 200 anchors sampled uniformly across failure modes + 50 adversarial. We'll use 5-way consensus for anchors.

Ivy: noted. I'll create labeling task and assign to the 6 annotators, schedule starts 18:00 UTC.

Liam: I'll run q8 vs fp16 regression on the golden set after labels, will push charts and failure examples.

Maya K: Perfect. If anyone spots major regressions, flag with `@eng-ml` and add example id. Thanks :raised_hands: 

Devon L: +1. Posting early TFs in #eng-runtime if we need kernel tweaks.

Ivy: CSV path + labeling board link: https://ourtools/boards/curation/2812345678

Maya K: closing the loop — next update by 2812345940 with bench + label status.
